lines.en: Uma, have you heard about our neighbour, Mr Hale? He is said to be abroad, but nobody knows where.
lines.pt: Uma, você ouviu falar do nosso vizinho, o Sr. Hale? Dizem que ele está no exterior, mas ninguém sabe onde.

lines.en: Yes, he is believed to have left in March. His house is known to have been empty for months.
lines.pt: Sim, acredita-se que ele partiu em março. Sabe-se que a casa está vazia há meses.

lines.en: The post office is reported to be holding his letters, and they are thought to pile up every day.
lines.pt: Dizem que o correio está guardando as cartas dele, e acredita-se que elas se acumulam todo dia.

lines.en: He is understood to be working for a shipping company, which is said to be based far from here.
lines.pt: Entende-se que ele trabalha para uma empresa de transporte marítimo, que fica longe daqui, segundo dizem.

lines.en: Far away? Really? He is supposed to be retired. He is known to hate flying, too.
lines.pt: Longe daí? Sério? Ele devia estar aposentado. Sabe-se que ele odeia voar também.

lines.en: People are said to change when they are bored. Maybe he is expected to come back soon.
lines.pt: Dizem que as pessoas mudam quando estão entediadas. Talvez se espere que ele volte logo.

lines.en: His brother is believed to have a spare key, so someone is likely to check the house.
lines.pt: Acredita-se que o irmão dele tenha uma chave reserva, então alguém deve conferir a casa.

lines.en: The garden is thought to have been neglected, because the grass is said to be a metre high.
lines.pt: Pensa-se que o jardim foi abandonado, porque dizem que o mato está com um metro de altura.

lines.en: Poor man. He is considered to be a kind person, so I hope he is not in trouble.
lines.pt: Coitado. Ele é considerado uma pessoa gentil, então espero que não esteja em apuros.

lines.en: The police are reported to have asked the family, but nothing is known to have happened.
lines.pt: Relata-se que a polícia perguntou à família, mas não se sabe de nada que tenha acontecido.

lines.en: Then let’s wait. People who are believed to be missing often turn out to be fine.
lines.pt: Então vamos esperar. Pessoas que se acredita estarem desaparecidas costumam aparecer bem.

facts.big: sujeito + is / are said / believed / known to + verbo
facts.label: Passivo de relato com infinitivo
facts.sub: Use o sujeito real. Presente: He is believed to be abroad. Passado: He is believed to have left. Plural: They are thought to pile up.

facts.label: Dizem que ele…
facts.sub: Use sujeito + is said to + verbo para dizer o que dizem sobre alguém: He is said to be abroad. Em português: “Dizem que ele…”. Para o plural, use are said to.

facts.label: Ação passada
facts.sub: Para falar do passado, use to have + particípio: He is believed to have left in March. A estrutura tem dois tempos: o relato é do presente e a ação é do passado.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “He is said to be abroad” means people say he is abroad.
We say “He is believed be abroad”.
items.why: We say is believed to be abroad.

items.s: “is known to have left” talks about the past.
items.why: Have + participle shows a past action.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “He is said to be abroad” means people say he is abroad. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “He is believed be abroad”. → Falso (We say is believed to be abroad.)
“is known to have left” talks about the past. → Verdadeiro (Have + participle shows a past action.)

pages.title: The neighbour who disappeared · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy afternoon in Wellington, as usual. Ela and Ana are leaving a small shop on their street. Across the road, a house looks dark and silent. Its owner has not been seen for weeks. The neighbours have started to talk. The two women stop and look at the empty house.

“Ana, have you heard about our neighbour, Mr Hale? He is said to be abroad, but nobody knows where.” says Ela. “Yes, he is believed to have left in March. His house is known to have been empty for months.” says Ana. “The post office is reported to be holding his letters, and they are thought to pile up every day.” says Ela.
